newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldova sees 97 gross grain crop up to 2.9 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Moldova sees 97 gross grain crop up to 2.9 mln T.

text.p: Moldova has forecast its 1997 gross grain harvest at 2.9 million tonnes, sharply up on 1996's level, an Agriculture Ministry official said on Monday.
"This is 60 percent more than last year, when the grain harvest was heavily hit by drought", Valentin Morari, deputy head of the ministry's crops-growing section, told Reuters.
Moldova has sown 70,000 hectares to wheat and pulses and plans to sow 350,000-360,000 hectares to maize (corn) by the end of April.
Sowing has been delayed due to a late spring, but the main obstacle has been a lack of cash and fuel.
"If we had enough fuel for tractors, we would have completed the grains sowing", Morari said.
Moldova harvested 830,000 tonnes of wheat and peas in 1996 and 987,000 tonnes of maize.
Moldova will also sow 82,000 hectares to sugar beets and 139,000 hectares to sunflower this year, seeking to harvest 2.3-2.5 million tonnes of sugar beets and 264 thousand tonnes of sunflower seeds.
Moldova harvested 1.8 million tonnes of beets and 276,000 tonnes of sunflower seeds last year.
